c7-generator.solution:
events = []
def readings():
    events.append("start")
    yield 10
    events.append("resume")
    yield 20
stream = readings()
before = events.copy()
first = next(stream)
after_first = events.copy()
second = next(stream)
after_second = events.copy()
c7-generator.wrong:
events = []
def readings():
    events.append("start")
    yield 10
    events.append("resume")
    yield 20
stream = readings()
before = events
first = next(stream)
after_first = events
second = next(stream)
after_second = events
